title: The Binding of Isaac
description: God tests Abraham by asking him to sacrifice his son Isaac on a mountain in the land of Moriah. Abraham obeys, but just as he raises the knife, the angel of the Lord calls out from heaven and stops him. A ram that has become entangled in a thicket is sacrificed instead, and God promises to bless Abraham's descendants.

versions.title: The Binding of Isaac
versions.description: God tests Abraham by asking him to sacrifice Isaac. At the last moment, an angel intervenes and provides a ram as a substitute.
